description:
Goal
Make the artifact ladder classify call return flow from settled TransportPlan facts, then carry that classification through BackendProgram. Native lowering must not rediscover return-flow shape by comparing repr vectors.

Design
Add an explicit call-return-flow record to MaterializedCallEdge, AbiReadyCallEdge, EmissionReadyCallEdge, and BackendTail direct/closure calls. The record should distinguish Tail, Continue-through-ReturnPayload, and Deliver-through-ResumePayload using TransportPosition identities, not locally derived shapes.

Strategy
In jobs/artifact.rs, resolve the flow once from ControlDestination plus TransportPlan positions: Deliver(entry) uses ResumePayload; Return uses ExecutableReturn for caller/callee and the new ReturnPayload position. Tail is allowed only when the settled contracts are identical by fact, not because a later stage can coerce them. Backend lowering copies the resolved flow unchanged.

Signal
Artifact/backend tests assert multi_relay carries a non-tail ReturnPayload flow before native lowering runs, and a simple same-contract call carries Tail. Tests must assert TransportPosition identity and ShapeId facts, not just AbiValueRepr equality.

Required edits
src/compiler2/artifact.rs, src/compiler2/jobs/artifact.rs, src/compiler2/jobs/backend.rs, relevant drive tests, outline.md/proposal.html if terminology moves.

Removal target
No new compatibility mode. No adapter structs. No repr-vector comparison as the authority for choosing call return flow.

Checks
Focused artifact/backend tests, cargo check, and rg for the old mismatched-tail-return phrasing in live tests/docs.
title: Transport return-flow: carry resolved call return flow through artifact and backend
